en: The soldier head is dark brown to blackish, glossy and densely pubescent, with blackish brown mandibles and a pale greyish yellow body. The head is short and oblong with parallel sides, a slightly concave front and an almost straight hind margin. The labrum is semicircular with a faintly concave tip; each hook-like mandible has a large blunt tooth at or behind the apical third and a minute tooth above the base. Antennae have 14 segments and the pronotum is saddle-shaped.
soldier: 头深褐而带黑，富光泽，密被短柔毛，前缘与上颚黑褐，胸腹淡灰黄。头长方形而略短，两侧缘平行，前缘稍凹，后缘近平；上唇半圆形，唇端微凹；上颚钩状，两颚各有一大钝齿位于颚端三分之一处或稍后，颚基上方各具一微齿；触角十四节，第三节稍长于第二节；后颏棍棒状，腰狭零点二五至零点二八毫米；前胸背板马鞍状，后缘中央稍凹并低陷。
